question: The rate at which RBI lends to commercial banks for the short term is called ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Repo Rate**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Repo rate** is the rate at which the central bank of a country (Reserve Bank of India in case of India) lends money to commercial banks in the event of any shortfall of funds.
 
• Repo rate is used by monetary authorities to control inflation.
